name: QlickCRM Integration for Gravity Forms
author: QlickCRM

sections.description:
QlickCRM Integration for Gravity Forms allows you to automatically send Gravity Forms form submissions to your QlickCRM account.

After connecting your QlickCRM API credentials, you can:

  • Map any Gravity Forms form to a QlickCRM module or partner record type
  • Define field mappings between Gravity Forms fields and QlickCRM fields
  • Automatically create or update CRM records on every form submission
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Gravity Forms.
  2. Upload and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to QlickCRM Gravity Forms in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your QlickCRM URL and API key to connect your account.
  5. Add a new form integration and configure the field mappings.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Warning on the field mapping page when a required CRM field (marked with *) is not mapped yet
  • The CRM “Name” (Megnevezés) field can now be filled with a free-text value instead of a Gravity Forms field
  • Free-text values are restricted to the CRM “Name” field, enforced both in the UI and on the server side

1.0.0

  • Initial release
